512: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("MultiTurnAttackBideThenReturnDoubleDamage",
513:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
514:     # Useless if no foe has any damaging moves
515:     has_damaging_move = false
516:     ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
517:       next if b.status == :SLEEP && b.statusCount > 2
518:       next if b.status == :FROZEN
519:       has_damaging_move = true if b.check_for_move { |m| m.damagingMove? }
520:       break if has_damaging_move
521:     end
522:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !has_damaging_move
523:     # Don't prefer if the user isn't at high HP
524:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
525:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.hp <= user.totalhp / 4
526:       score -= 15 if user.hp <= user.totalhp / 2

528:     end
